summary: The volunteer who wants a real job: {volunteer}, who has knocked doors for weeks, asks for a staff job over a hired professional.
realLife: Her 1970 campaign office offered free drop-in child care, and she pushed to promote women from canvassers into staff jobs.
choices: set up child care at the office so parents can volunteer

branches.when: many of your volunteers are parents
branches.then: Child care at the office changes who can come.
They come back to ask for your endorsement.
